prefix_review.momentum_budget_definition: 1e-9 times each body's absolute particle momentum plus absolute accumulated fixture/contact impulse, with a 1e-30 Ns scale floor.
prefix_review.scope: Complete raw prefix, static labels, accepted state/clock and independently reconstructed momentum/kinetic energy. Local constitutive forces and full-period physical admissibility are not independently re-solved here; no media or calibrated response approval.

material_review.scope: Independent final F/SVD reconstruction at fixed damage. Saved K+U change minus actual fixture/contact work is reported, not assumed conserved. APIC losses, changing contact curvature and adhesive snap preclude a global conservative-contact claim. Full-time F and local contact equilibria are not independently reconstructed.
